notes.title: Milly the dog - Next step
notes.content:

notes.title: Improved game experience
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Equinox in stage 2 now just follow/attack Milly when it's here. Before Equinox follow Milly all the stage so now to dig for treasures is quite easy than before.
[*] Achievement Master of Milly the dog just need more than 100000 XP points (before you need 1 million)
[*] Some other achievement issues solved.
[*] In stage 3 Milly seems to walk over a couple of trees now goes from behind. 
[/list]

notes.title: Milly the dog
notes.content:
You are Milly, a cute dog, that started a travel to look for all his toys living a non-stop adventure through 3 fun and colorful stages full of surprises.

When you have found all the toys hidden in all the maps you have unlock [b]7 mini-games[/b]:
[list]
[*] Catch the ball
[*] Flying disk
[*] Rodeo
[*] Clean Milly
[*] Agility contest
[*] Race track
[*] All the stars
[/list]

Milly the dog is a game for kids of all ages.
Recommended ages between 6+ and 12 years old

It is ideal to play with your children 3+ next to you
